comparison.objective: Candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs; record swaps a dust filter beneath a spring-shut cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests aligned impact and fragment recovery; record requires one arm to hold a spring-loaded pedal while the other removes, bins, and inserts filters.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires valid fractures, containment, retention, and no damage; record requires dirty-filter disposal, new-filter seating, cover closure, and arm retreat. No specs add numeric tolerances.
comparison.reason: The shared bimanual coordination is generic; spring-cover management and filter replacement test different physical outcomes.
